iron.name: Iron Sight
iron.description: Standard iron sight. No magnification. Quick to aim.

red_dot.name: Red Dot
red_dot.description: 1x red dot. Clean reticle, fast target acquisition.

holo.name: Holographic
holo.description: 1x holographic. Wide FOV reticle for tracking.

hunter.name: Hunter 2x
hunter.description: 2x low-magnification scope. Faster ADS than the 6x sniper scope, with less precise aimed shots.

thermal.name: Thermal 6x
thermal.description: 6x thermal scope. Highlights heat signatures at long range with slower handling.

nvg.name: NVG Scope
nvg.description: Night vision scope. Brightens dark scenes with green tint.

laser.name: Laser Sight
laser.description: Iron sight + visible laser indicator. Tightens hipfire.

sniper_scope.name: Sniper Scope
sniper_scope.description: Base 6x sniper scope. Standard on all bolt-action rifles. Long-range precision.
